visualReview.review: Reviewed the actual desktop, mobile and 1200 by 900 preview PNGs. Charcoal and citron composition keeps the single email action prominent, with generous centered hierarchy and subtle perimeter arcs. The stacked mobile form has large targets and fully readable copy; the whole initial composition fits the 390 by 900 viewport without clipping. Printable download, invalid email handling, reset and privacy disclosure all passed.
